items.title: How Tactical Buyers Should Play Costco Today
items.summary: Costco has compounded its membership base, its warehouses, and its earnings at an impressive clip, yet the stock has gone nowhere for a year while the broader market climbed 21%. The question worth sitting with is whether the next big move belongs to patient buyers or to those already holding.

items.title: The Treasury Has Now Refunded $100 Billion Of Tariff Revenue, and Scott Bessent Predicts None of It Is Going to You
